description: This file defines interfaces and enums for serializing frames in the Pipecat project. It includes an enumeration for serialization formats and an abstract base class for serializers, outlining the methods subclasses must implement to handle serialization logic, setup, and type identification.

classes.name: FrameSerializerType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported frame serialization formats, including BINARY and TEXT.

classes.name: FrameSerializer
classes.description: Abstract base class that defines the interface for frame serialization implementations, requiring methods for setup, serialize, deserialize, and a property for type.

methods.name: FrameSerializerType type(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the FrameSerializerType supported by this serializer.

methods.name: setup(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with startup configuration using a StartFrame.

methods.name: str|bytes|None serialize(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Converts a Frame object into a serialized form, returning string, bytes, or None.

methods.name: Frame|None deserialize(self, data: str | bytes)
methods.description: Converts serialized data back into a Frame object, returning None if failed.

ctags.name: deserialize
ctags.pattern: /^    async def deserialize(self, data: str | bytes) -> Frame | None:$/

ctags.name: serialize
ctags.pattern: /^    async def serialize(self, frame: Frame) -> str | bytes | None:$/
